inputs.utterance: Why did the deploy go out with the old stylesheet?
inputs.answer: The build copied the previous bundle because the asset step ran before the stylesheet step finished. The stylesheet step writes after the bundle is copied, so its output was never included. Move the copy step after the stylesheet step and the next deploy will carry it.

inputs.utterance: Why does the test pass locally but fail in CI?
inputs.answer: CI runs with an empty home directory, so the test reads a missing config and falls back to the wrong port. Locally your config exists, so it picks the right one. Give the test its own config fixture and it will pass in both places.

inputs.utterance: The laptop fan is loud even when it is idle. Why?
inputs.answer: A background index process is still scanning after the last update finished. It holds one core busy, so the fan stays up until the scan ends. Quit the indexer and the fan should settle within a minute.

inputs.utterance: Why is the form saving an empty name?
inputs.answer: The name field is read before the browser restores its stored value, so the first submit sends an empty string. Reading it on submit instead of on load fixes it. The fix is one line in the handler.

inputs.utterance: Why did the query get slower after the index change?
inputs.answer: The new index leads with the status column, which almost every row shares, so the planner walks most of the table anyway. Drop the status column from the index and it can seek straight to the user rows. That should bring the time back under 20ms.

inputs.utterance: Why has the weekly report stopped arriving?
inputs.answer: The job is scheduled for Sunday morning, and the server clock moved to a timezone where that is still Saturday, so the scheduler never reaches the window. Set the schedule in UTC and it will run again. The next run is tomorrow.

inputs.utterance: Why does the image look washed out on the phone?
inputs.answer: The page ships an untagged colour profile, so the phone guesses sRGB and clips the wider colours. Tag the images as Display P3 and the phone will keep them. Only the phone is affected.

inputs.utterance: Why did my calendar invite land at the wrong hour?
inputs.answer: The invite was created without a timezone, so each recipient's client filled in its own. It reads as 9am in London and 9am in Sydney. Create it with an explicit timezone and it will land at one moment for everyone.

inputs.utterance: Should we use a queue or call the worker directly?
inputs.answer: A queue costs one more moving part but survives a worker restart, retries cleanly and lets you drain it during a deploy. Calling directly is simpler and has no extra service, but a failed call is simply lost. With your volume a queue is the safer default; direct calls are fine for a prototype.

inputs.utterance: Postgres or SQLite for this side project?
inputs.answer: SQLite needs no server, ships as one file and is plenty fast for a single machine, but it struggles with many concurrent writers. Postgres handles concurrency and gives you managed backups, at the cost of running a service. For a one-machine tool SQLite wins; for a team app Postgres does.

inputs.utterance: Which is better for the landing page, a video or a still image?
inputs.answer: A video shows the product moving and holds attention longer, but it is heavier, needs a poster frame and drains battery on phones. A still image loads instantly and is easier to make accessible, but it shows less. Use the still on mobile and the video on desktop.

inputs.utterance: Should I renew the domain for one year or five?
inputs.answer: One year keeps you flexible and costs less now, but the price may rise and you have to remember it. Five years locks the current price and removes the annual chore, though it commits money to a name you might drop. Five years is cheaper per year; one year is better if the project might fold.

inputs.utterance: Dark mode or light mode for the dashboard?
inputs.answer: Dark mode suits long sessions and makes charts glow, but small grey text gets harder to read and screenshots look heavy. Light mode reads better in daylight and prints cleanly, but is harsher at night. Offer both and default to the system setting.

inputs.utterance: How do I add a new page to the site?
inputs.answer: Create a file under pages with the route name, export a component that returns the markup, and add a link in the navigation. The router picks it up from the filename, so no registration is needed.
